description.text: The eighth Sun & Moon set, released on 2 November 2018 with 236 cards: 214 and 22 secret rares, which made it the largest English set yet. It draws on Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon and on Johto, and brought the first cards of the Mythical Zeraora, as Zeraora-GX. It has 13 Pokémon-GX, among them Lugia-GX, Tyranitar-GX and Blacephalon-GX, seven Prism Star cards, three of them Stadiums, and nine gold full-art Trainers among its secret rares.
